folds.heading: ## Continuous content reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B66)
folds.body: Preserve the root review’s corrections over the earlier lane shorthand: L3’s mana-signal/day-night additions are conditional on selected interactions, L2’s original prices/rescue/utility effects do not require invented primary-canon evidence, and L4’s existing compatibility deferral does not ask for fresh approval on every new state. L4’s listed unread JJK brief ranges remain unread in that lane; this full review of its report does not supply them. WPD-F1’s three HP windows, two census edits and read/read-window counts keep their original input identity and scope; raw novel/wiki/census sources were not reopened here. WG1–WG26 are bounded dispositions with local remainders, not full-file/world completion or a current implementation queue. Current JJK packet still records its parked build. WPD-N3’s old LOTM prototype gaps are route/input-specific history: later named receipts may close their own journeys without certifying every life, current build or source-law catalogue. AD42 keeps human play/fiction feedback optional; AD36/AD43 govern actual changed behavior proof. Useful sample/lot/time, custody versus knowledge, method versus permission and clock distinctions remain with the linked local owners.

folds.heading: ## Coverage interpretation, 2026-11-04 (B66)
folds.body: The [root reconciliation](REPORT.md#continuous-content-reconciliation-2026-11-04-b66) preserves WG1–WG26 and lane-specific source limits. “All scopes have a disposition” is the dated audit denominator, not every source/file read or all worlds implemented. Consult current local direction and actual route receipts before treating old pending status as current. Source evidence qualifies source claims; original local scenario values remain labelled authored. No parked world is selected or proposal adopted by this matrix (AD32).
